name: ABot-World
description: A real-time interactive world simulator that turns a single desktop GPU into an infinite action-conditioned world generator. It allows users to continuously explore and interact with the environment rather than passively watching pre-rendered video.
keyFeatures: Runs at 720p and 16 FPS on a single RTX 5090
Supports infinite world rollout without scene lock-in
Operates with 1.2s latency and a 19GB GPU memory footprint
